eligibility.title: Eligibility

benefits.title: Benefits & commission
benefits.description: What you get as an agent.

rulesItems: Only one agent application can be submitted per account.
Fake, multiple or self-referral sales are not accepted.
An approved application is required for agent benefits to activate.
Even after approval your account stays a customer account — only the agent badge and reseller benefits are added.
Benefits may be removed if a breach of the rules is proven.
eligibilityItems: You must have an active and verified RizqifyBD customer account.
The account must not be suspended or deleted.
You must agree to the programme's terms and conditions.
Sales and promotion must be conducted honestly and transparently.
Benefits continue as long as you keep actively selling.
benefitsItems: Attractive commission on every successful sale.
Commission goes straight to your wallet — easy to withdraw.
An agent (reseller) badge on your profile and dashboard.
Full tracking and reports from your dashboard.
